questions: Did Dr Uriah secretly make a copy of the treasure map that turned is wrong?

Did Trout capture the invisible thief in his one-use fish bag, which he never got back?

Did the party escape the giant after it woke, with the giant eventually giving up the chase?
Did Trout accidentally hit Squints in the head with a sling shot meant to cover their escape?
Did Brother Dirk want to go home, only for the party to pressure him to continue onward?
Is Waymon Tisdale a fishman assassin?
Did the party hire Drop Dead Ned to accompany them to the barrow mound for 100 gold for the week, split 33 gold each?
Did Ned agree to pay the party back 10 gold each time they let him murder someone?
Is Ned allowed to do whatever he wants with the bodies of people he's permitted to murder?
Did Ned bring his killer wasp in a jar?

Did the players roll a six-sided die to determine which side was surprised at the start of combat?
